purpose: REAL_DFT baseline for the new ETKDG-free classifier

cohort.label: REAL_DFT (new module, no ETKDG, no RDKit)

interpretation_rules: This cohort IS the like-for-like baseline for a future GENERATED measurement that uses the same module on sampled clouds. It must be re-derived whenever the module's tolerance values change.
Numbers should match cfm_metal_geometry.json::cohorts.REAL_DFT under the round-1 instrument measure_dft_frame; any drift indicates a tolerance change.

corrections_2026_10_12_evening.summary: Several prose claims made in the prior §9.4 (docs/CFM_STATUS_2026_10_12.md) about the values in this JSON were stale or numerically wrong. The values in THIS file are the ground truth; the prose that misquoted them is withdrawn. The corrections are: (1) Pt bond median 2.1832 was from the round-1 instrument, not this JSON -- the new value is 2.1735 (per_metal.Pt.median); (2) the 'Within 3%' claim is FALSE for T-4 (real -12.9% off) and for oct (real -4.87% off); (3) the 'Mean 2.179 matches 2.180 to 4 decimals' claim is FALSE -- the JSON's mean is 2.179 (not 2.180), and the round-1 mean was a different number; (4) the '2847/3000 frames' claim misrepresents the count -- 2847 were SCORED out of 2848 CLOUDS (=99.96% of clouds; 3000 was the original SAMPLE REQUEST, of which 2848 passed the metal-centre check and 1 was rejected as implausible); (5) the trigonal-prism 'explanation' of why T-4 was -12.9% off was FABRICATED -- h=r in a right triangle gives 53.13 / 101.54 / 126.87 degrees, which is not in (90, 100) and not the criterion this classifier uses.
what_was_wrong: Prose claim: 'Pt bond median 2.1832 (n=3571)'. Actual: 2.1735 (n=3386). The 2.1832 was the round-1 instrument's value; this JSON's measurement supersedes it. Bond COUNT is also different (3386 not 3571, because the new instrument applies donor_cutoff_A=2.6 and rejects a few Pt clouds that the round-1 instrument kept).

Prose claim: 'Within 3%' of the real value for T-4 and oct. Actual: T-4 real fraction 27/499 = 5.41% vs generated ... (the generated arm is the one not yet scored; for the real arm, T-4 = 5.41% of CN=4 complexes). The 'within 3%' was claimed for a generated-vs-real comparison that has not been measured; the 'within 3%' wording should not have appeared in any context for this axis.

Prose claim: 'Mean 2.179 matches 2.180 to 4 decimals'. Actual: this JSON's mean IS 2.179 (line 115), not 2.180. The number 2.180 was the round-1 instrument's number. The two numbers are not 'the same to 4 decimals'; the third decimal differs.

Prose claim: '2847/3000 frames'. Actual: 2847 scored out of 2848 clouds (=99.96% of clouds that had a metal centre). 3000 was the SAMPLE REQUEST, not the population -- 152 of the 3000 sampled were rejected for missing the metal-centre check (n_clouds=2848) and 1 additional was rejected for implausible geometry (n_geometries_scored=2847).

Prose claim: trigonal-prism TBP/90-deg angles explain why T-4 is off. Actual: this classifier's T-4 criterion is NOT 90-degree angles -- it is a trans_pair count of 0/1 (no trans pair, so classified as T-4) vs 2 (classified as square_planar). The trigonal-prism / 90-deg explanation was made up to fill a gap and does not match the module's logic.
what_was_landed_2026_10_12: Updated docs/CFM_STATUS_2026_10_12.md §9.4 to use this JSON's values: Pt 2.1735 (n=3386), Ru 2.2647 (n=5504), Ir 2.2045 (n=3404), Rh 2.2029 (n=2232), Os 2.2383 (n=786), Re 2.1258 (n=2318); pooled 17,630 bonds, sd 0.1895; CN=4: 472 SP / 27 T (94.6% SP of 499); CN=6: 1093 octahedral_like / 6 no_trans_pair; CN mean 6.1924.
Added a NOTE 2026-10-12 (corrections_round1) callout in §9.4 listing the five withdrawn prose claims and pointing readers to this corrections block for full detail.
Appended this corrections_2026_10_12_evening block to the JSON itself, so the file is the source of truth and any future read of the JSON carries the disclaimer.
what_is_NOT_changed: All numeric values in this JSON (n_clouds=2848, n_geometries_scored=2847, coordination_number_mean=6.1924, geometry_class_counts, cn4_geometry_class_counts, metal_bond_length_A, metal_bond_length_per_metal_A, donor_element_counts, donor_element_top5_fraction, planarity_ratio fields) are UNCHANGED. The JSON is the ground truth; the corrections are about prose claims ABOUT the JSON, not the JSON itself.

cfm_metal_geometry.json's REAL_DFT cohort and the round-1 instrument (measure_dft_frame) are separate cohorts. The 6,872 vs 5,754 population gap documented in cfm_metal_geometry.json::corrections_2026_10_12[0] is unrelated to the overstatements corrected here.
corrections_2026_10_12_evening.downstream_decision_recorded_not_acted_o: Re-running the generated arm against this real baseline (the actual generated-vs-real T-4 / SP / oct fractions) is the next experiment in cfm_todo.json::next_actions[0] -- the decode-enabled guidance sweep. Until that runs, the 'Within 3%' / 'matches 2.180 to 4 decimals' / 'trigonal-prism' prose was always incorrect (the generated arm is not yet measured) and the corrections above are independent of that future measurement.
